title: seccomp BPF filter (sock_filter / seccomp_data)
summary: A seccomp filter is a BPF program (array of sock_filter instructions) that inspects each syscall via a seccomp_data structure. Each 8-byte sock_filter: code (2 bytes), jt (1 byte), jf (1 byte), k (4 bytes). The filter returns SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS, SECCOMP_RET_KILL_THREAD, SECCOMP_RET_TRAP, SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO, SECCOMP_RET_TRACE, SECCOMP_RET_LOG, or SECCOMP_RET_ALLOW.

structure.meaning: IP at the time of the syscall.

notes: Classic BPF (cBPF) is used for seccomp; eBPF is used for tracing/profiling.
SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO returns an errno without killing the process.
SECCOMP_RET_TRACE notifies a tracer (ptrace) and lets it modify the syscall.
Filters are applied per-thread; SECCOMP_SET_MODE_FILTER applies to the calling thread and its children.
seccomp is the foundation of container sandboxing (Docker, gVisor, Firecracker's jailer).
